cases.given: Two listings share a local symbol but have different MICs.
cases.expected: Resolve only with an explicit listing identity; ambiguous input cannot create a holding.

cases.given: Each of nine listing/source/plan rows is evaluated for six uses.
cases.expected: Unknown scope blocks use. Written evidence enables only the exact named scope.

cases.given: A correction arrives after a forecast origin.
cases.expected: Keep the original manifest immutable; restated evaluation creates a new version.

cases.given: VOD is 125 GBX; a USD 201 value uses GBP 0.80 per USD.
cases.expected: Values are GBP 1.25 andGBP 160.80, with unit conversion applied once.

cases.given: NAV is published late and has no traded bar fields.
cases.expected: Do not invent 30-minute prices; origins wait and cannot consume the NAV before known_at.

cases.given: A DST mismatch week, half-day and holiday affect sessions. Proposed four-clock daily schedule and a source with nonzero collection latency.
cases.expected: Use the local versioned calendar; do not use fixed UTC offsets or holiday monitoring. Collection +15m and retry +40m can complete before frozen +60m cutoff; issue by +75m and strictly before next open. Late known_at is excluded without shifting cutoff; unsupported next-open schedule abstains.
cases.offline_specification_proof: python3 docs/planning/foundation-specifications-2026-11-02/forecasting/timing_checks.py --check daily; ordinary/retry latency success, late ingestion/publication/issue and next-open conflict

cases.given: Two jobs concurrently request the last five credits.
cases.expected: At most one passes the combined atomic minute/day reservation.

cases.given: A partial batch returns 429 and a request times out before 00:00 UTC.
cases.expected: Keep per-item outcomes and ambiguous liability; daily reset does not erase history.

cases.given: A synthetic fixture runs while live mode is disabled.
cases.expected: Make zero network requests, preserve the mode label and make no live-proof claim.

cases.given: Live receipts for the US, UK and India examples are requested.
cases.expected: Require actual account, named plan, listing, endpoint, intended-use grants, timestamp and delay evidence; these remain pending.

cases.given: A split is announced before its effective date and a dividend is paid later.
cases.expected: Version adjustments as of the cutoff, record cash at the proper date and avoid total-return double counting.

cases.given: A grant is revoked while backups and trained models exist.
cases.expected: Stop new use, invalidate affected derivations and apply the approved retention/disposition policy with protected decision evidence.

cases.given: A Grow 55 /dividends call for one listing, and a /splits check scheduled on the Basic dev account.
cases.expected: Reserve 20 credits for the Grow call; reject the Basic check as unsupported; never reserve weight 1 for an action endpoint.

cases.given: Claude proposes a watch-only listing from chat; once with no owner confirm, once with unsupported coverage, once over the minute-credit cap, once confirmed.
cases.expected: Only the confirmed, covered, affordable proposal creates a new catalogue version with the approval record; its capability starts at candidate.

cases.given: Grow 55 first month: one UK fund returns a NAV, one does not; an Indian fund statement is imported.
cases.expected: The covered UK fund gets a verified capability; the uncovered one and the Indian fund are valued from owner statements with their valuation date and age; no plan upgrade is triggered.

cases.given: A prod Grow 55 daily bar is stored and used for training under OWNER-RISK-01; a request then tries to export it to a third party.
cases.expected: Storage and training proceed as risk_accepted (never granted); the export is denied. Sending values to Anthropic is covered by DATA-AT-19 and DATA-AT-20 (DATA-DEC-12 answered, owner, 3 Nov 2026).

cases.given: XAU/USD at 2,400.00 USD per troy ounce with a pinned 0.80 GBP per USD.
cases.expected: GBP 1,920.0000 per troy ounce, converted once; no corporate-action lookup; coverage stays live_proof_pending until the live account proves it.

cases.given: Under OWNER-RISK-01's scopes: a Basic dev daily bar is sent to a dev screen; a Yahoo delayed XLON quote feeds a 30-minute check; a Yahoo daily close is offered as training input; a Grow 55 /splits record and an XAU/USD daily bar are stored and used for training; a Grow 55 fundamentals record is stored.
cases.expected: The dev screen display is denied (Basic is non-display only; dev shows synthetic data); the Yahoo quote check proceeds as risk_accepted; the Yahoo training input is denied until DATA-DEC-15 is answered; the split and XAU/USD uses proceed as risk_accepted (scopes S3 and S1); the fundamentals record is denied because no scope names that data kind.

cases.given: A prod Claude explanation route whose allowlist names a listing's 20-day return, its forecast range, its combined score and its latest Grow 55 close sends those four values for one listing; another sends a Yahoo cross-check disagreement as a quality flag.
cases.expected: Both transmissions proceed as risk_accepted with basis owner_risk_acceptance under OWNER-RISK-01-S9 and S10 (never granted); the vendor cells stay unknown; the answer is shown to the owner only.

cases.given: A prod Claude prompt carries a bulk raw series: 250 Grow 55 daily closes for one listing; a second carries a Yahoo intraday quote stream; a third carries a raw close the route's allowlist does not name; a fourth carries Basic dev values.
cases.expected: All four are refused before the request leaves MP, with the refusal recorded; no anthropic_transmission record is written for them, because no scope covers a bulk raw series or feed, a raw field outside the allowlist, or Basic dev values (DATA-DEC-12).
